material_choice: Wrought17-4PH ConditionH900; no cast/AM equivalent, no unaged ConditionA substitution.

cost_boundary.cost_rationale: No extra adapter/space/fastener; only tiny custom slider material changes. Small-lot machining, root finishing and certified heat treatment likely dominate raw stock.

procurement_requirements.standards: UNS S17400 / ASTM A564 bar or AMS5643, material and heat treatment certificate; procurement minimum yield1170MPa must be explicitly accepted by supplier, not inferred from a typical-property value.

process_requirements.heat_treatment: Certified solution-treated wrought stock; H900482±5°C for60±5min then air cool, with batch coupon/certification. Prefer certified pre-aged bar followed by finish machining, or rough machine ConditionA then age and finish-grind mating faces.
process_requirements.final_tolerance_requirement: Re-measure both20µm side clearances, rootR.1,1mmweb andflatness after heat treatment; proposed tongue width±.005mm and parallelism/flatness≤.01mm require process qualification. No new geometry tolerance is silently added to frozen source.
process_requirements.surface_finish_proposal_not_measured: Finish-grind/lap sliding flanks Ra≤.8µm, deburr without reducingR.1 roots. Not an achieved surface measurement.

wear_and_life_boundary.counterfaces: Existing C45_QT lower output flange and upper hub/shaft retained; separate SKF bearings still carry belt load.
wear_and_life_boundary.lubrication: Existing grease/wear requirement retained. Grease compatibility and replenishment intervals need bench qualification; no dry-running or unlubricated endurance claim.
risks: Harder H900 slider may transfer wear to softer C45 grooves; inspect backlash/scuffing and grease debris.
H900 peak-strength material has lower impact toughness and poorer chloride-SCC margin than higher-temperature-aged states; no crash/cleaning-chemical/fatigue certification.
Reversed torque, misalignment, impact and unilateral sliding contact are not covered by the bilateral linear FE screen.

integration_boundary: Only retire the two exact Oldham occurrences after source identity matches formal07; add raw MCI deltas without overwriting07 whole-body masses. No direct runtime cap approval. Owner must separately adopt motor+slider packet and remaining transmission assumptions.
owner_decision_boundary: Owner accepts only finite static hardwareA/B prototype at1.8Nm continuous chain cap; not2Nm, no lifetime/manufacturing qualification. Existing runtime07 remains unchanged.
